instruction: I forgot my password and cannot log in.
response: Use the Forgot Password link on the sign-in page, then follow the reset email.

instruction: How can I change the email on my account?
response: Open Account Settings, choose Email, enter the new address, and verify it from the email we send.
Please share the transaction dates and last four card digits so we can investigate the duplicate charge.
Refunds are returned to the original payment method. Processing normally takes 5 to 10 business days.

instruction: How do I cancel my subscription?
response: Go to Billing Settings, select your plan, and choose Cancel subscription. Access continues until the current billing period ends.

instruction: Can I update my shipping address?
response: You can update the shipping address in Orders before the order is dispatched.
Check the tracking link in your order email. If the delivery date has passed, contact support with your order number.

instruction: The product I received is damaged.
response: Send photos of the damaged item and your order number. We will arrange a replacement or refund.

instruction: I need an invoice for my purchase.
response: Download your invoice from Order History by opening the order and selecting Download invoice.

instruction: Which payment methods do you accept?
response: We accept major credit and debit cards and the payment methods shown during checkout.
